title: Comparison in Efficacy and Safety Between Interferon Alfacon-1 Alone and Concomitant Dosing With Ribavirin for the Treatment of Hepatitis C
brief_summary: Efficacy and safety is compared between interferon alfacon-1 alone and concomitant dosing of interferon alfacon-1 and ribavirin in hepatitis C patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Hepatitis C patients (high titer, genotype1)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients with autoimmune disorder
* Patients with negative HBs antigen
* Patients with hepatic cirrhosis, hepatic failure and hepatic cancer
* Patients with depression or psychoneurotic disorder
